role: Five separate complete original source/contract reviews; shared compiler transport is not a low-risk behavior batch.

complete_original_hunk_reviews.decision: This root-facade hunk adds checkbox-base to the modern namespace and leaves the neighboring legacy exports alone. The untouched16.2.14 facade and both actual owned compiler runs omit this post16 name while retaining all seven selected modern/legacy names for checkbox. Adding the new export would expand the finite historical API and create a new consumer mixin requirement; decline it for the frozen compatibility facade.

This hunk creates a modern base mixin for MDC checkbox defaults, with its original selector wrapper and imports as shown in the authenticated hunk. Its purpose is to move unthemable values out of component structure so future design-system themes can choose them. The owned legacy theme at projects/ngx-material-legacy/styles/legacy-checkbox/_checkbox-theme.scss is byte-identical to the tagged reference and targets .mat-checkbox; it requires no such new stage. Preserve that historical allocation. The modern16 theme is also retained after MDC import relocation. This source exclusion introduces no empty replacement mixin.

This theme-body hunk unconditionally invokes base($theme) inside the existing duplicate-style guard before the color/density/typography branches. That changes the CSS emitted by the complete modern theme relative to partial mixins, including configurations with absent dimensions. The frozen16 owned theme keeps the original conditional sequence. All three legacy default outputs and the independent direct legacy color output for checkbox match the untouched oracle on each advertised installed Material floor; decline this new emission stage rather than making consumers add another include.

This structural hunk removes MDC checkbox default emission from the original modern component stylesheet. Its deletion is coupled to the new base export/call above, so it cannot be transplanted independently. The owned runtime metadata points to the retained legacy family stylesheet and .mat-checkbox structure; this patch does not edit the original legacy family. Keep the existing resource allocation and inspect its separately recorded pre-existing structural deltas under the full rendered/style audit. The narrow compiler checks here do not qualify those structural deltas or native behavior.

reviews.decision: Do not adopt the post16 checkbox-base API or the coupled default-style relocation. Preserve the finite16.2.14 Sass surface, original legacy checkbox theme/color/typography output and retained component resources. Current public peers own their modern implementations; no new legacy consumer include or CSS/SCSS change is required. This is an individually reviewed source-contract decision; packed/rendered/native and full floor/audit requirements remain separate.
